title: Tributary rollout playpad and telemetry lighthouse - 2027-03 (sketch)
body:
Context:
This is a working playpad for the Tributary rollout experiment (multi-lane, locality-aware gradual ramp). Purpose is to capture the minimal checklist, telemetry lighthouse (what we'll watch), and an explicit low-friction rollback drill so on-call can execute under stress.

Why 'tributary'?
- Multiple small traffic lanes feeding the main flow (good for model variants + region-based routing).
- We want to validate slow-heat canary behavior and noise-floor detection before scaling.

High-level goals:
- Validate cross-region prefix cache priming (KV cache hit-rate target >= 75% for 1s p95 latency slice).
- Ensure model-fallback choreography: when dedupe+quant variant fails, immediate fallback to baseline model within 500ms.
- Keep incremental cost delta < 12% during 72h ramp.

Quick runbook (compact):
- T-72h: Stakeholders "go/no-go" sync (ENG, Product, SRE, Observability). Record decision in Jira (RELEASE-432).
- T-48h: Preflight smoke on staging; KV cache snapshot; run mini-load generator to prime caches with common prefixes.
- T-24h: Canary lane config baked (traffic weights, region mapping, burst quotas). Post config as PR: runtime PR #2143.
- T-6h: Observability hooks activated: weave in tracing tags: tributary.lane, variant, region, cache-hit. Ensure dashboards are live.
- T0: Open quiet window and flip canary to 1% across three tributaries. Start telemetry sampler.
- T+1h: Increase to 5% if p95 latency and error rates stable.
- T+6h: If thresholds met, 20% add.
- T+24h: Re-evaluate with Product & SRE; decide to continue ramp or hold.
- T+72h: Full merge into main route if all gates pass.

Minimal checklist (operator-facing) - check these before each ramp step:
- [ ] Dashboard: tributary lighthouse visible (p50/p95 token latency by variant & region).
- [ ] Error budget: 5xx rate < 0.02% (rolling 1h) for each tributary.
- [ ] Cache: prefix/KV cache hit-rate >= 75% (sampled over 15m).
- [ ] Cost throttle preview: projected unit-cost delta <12% for projected QPS.
- [ ] Fallback mapping present in runtime routing table (variant -> baseline).
- [ ] Canary burst quotas configured and validated.
- [ ] Canary abort playbook linked in incident runbook (quick link).

Telemetry lighthouse (what to watch and action thresholds):
- p95 token latency (global): baseline + 30% => HOLD and notify SRE.
- p99 latency spike > baseline + 80% for >3m => ROLL BACK.
- 5xx rate across tributaries: >0.02% sustained >10m => STOP RAMP and investigate.
- Cache hit-rate drop >15 percentage points compared to preflight snapshot => PAUSE ramp and run cache re-prime job.
- Model output drift (quality): run small eval harness every 30m against the control prompt-set; if metric degradation > 3% (F1/rerank score) => HOLD and signal ML.

Noise-floor sampler (notes):
- Sampler job runs at T0 and every 30m: 200 synthetic queries per major prompt-set across variants & regions. Record: latency, tokens, prefix-hit, model-version, response checksum.
- Store sampler output in s3://deploy-tributary/sampler/2027-03-XX for postmortem.

Rollback mini-drill (explicit, 2-person rapid path):
- Trigger: any p99 > baseline + 80% for >3m or 5xx spike per threshold.
- Step 1: Notify on-call SRE and shift lead in #deploy-alerts (tag @oncall).
- Step 2: Execute runtime toggle to revert tributary lane weights to 0% (UI quick toggle or api: POST /runtime/route/rollback?lane=tributaryX).
- Step 3: Confirm traffic returned to baseline via traffic-sampler (samples show 0% to variant).
- Step 4: Run lightweight impact check (p95 back to baseline within 3m). If not, escalate to major incident.
- Post-drill: file after-action note in linked_confluence and tag RELEASE-432.

Open questions & TODOs (notes to self):
- How aggressive should the TTL for KV cache priming be? (30m vs 2h) -- leaning 1h.
- Need a short circuit to bypass quantized variant if memory pressure high. SRE to propose.
- Are cost throttle curves hooked into billing alerts? If not, we need quick stub.
- Confirm legal/regulatory check for region-specific routing (APAC privacy constraints). Elena to confirm.

Suggested dashboard tiles (for lighthouse):
- p95 token latency by variant + region (rolling 15m).
- p99 latency trend with annotations for ramp steps.
- KV prefix hit-rate (15m rolling) per tributary.
- Error rate 5xx per 10k requests, per variant.
- Sampler quality metric (weighted F1 / rerank) with control baseline.
- Cost rate per 1k tokens for the trial (projected vs actual).

Communications plan (short):
- Internal: #deploy-alerts for ops, #trib-playbook for cross-team chatter.
- Customer-facing: hold messages in draft in confluence; only publish if rollback affects customer SLAs.
- Exec: 24h and 72h summary updates (short bullets + one pager).

Post-rollout retro agenda (if merged):
- 15m quick data dump: latency, errors, cost delta, cache stats.
- 30m root cause / unexpected behavior deep-dive (if any).
- Action items: tuning, observability additions, documentation gaps.

Notes: this is intentionally compact and messy — use as the operational checklist during the week of the trial. Keep this doc as the ephemeral coordination pad; canonical specs should live in Confluence (link above).

Recent edits (log):
- 2027-03-02 Sofia: created initial skeleton and goals.
- 2027-03-03 Ravi: added noise-floor sampler plan and sampler S3 path.
- 2027-03-05 Elena: appended rollback mini-drill and added legal/regional TODO.

Quick links:
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2143
- Linear ticket: https://linear.app/RELEASE/issue/RELEASE-432
- Slack: #trib-playbook

Unresolved:
- final values for 'cost throttle' gate and cache priming TTL.
- who owns the postmortem if a rollback occurs (SRE vs release-eng).

-- end of playpad (sketch)
